integrity: One analytical finite-dimensional theorem, supplemented by an executable exact-arithmetic checker; computational samples are not treated as proof of universal assertions.
scientific_limitations: The solution gives all invariant optimal allocations and exact optimal values, but does not assert uniqueness of every unrestricted optimum; the objective is continuous-time Laplacian spectral gap and does not cover discrete-time SLEM. Priority relative to unindexed specialized literature is not independently established.
title: Two price thresholds in fastest mixing on a complete graph with a costly clique
